---
site: bookdown::bookdown_site
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)

# Absolute project root, so chapters can build paths independently of the
# working directory knitr happens to use.
options(mics6.guide.root = normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))

# Stata engine. Chapters show Stata code with eval=FALSE by default, so a
# local Stata installation is not required to build the book.
if (requireNamespace("Statamarkdown", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(Statamarkdown)
}
```
